title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-4n5v: test multi_fragment_single_window broken after tile_size removal
description:
## Severity: P1 (test break)

`rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs` test `multi_fragment_single_window` (line 58) will fail:

- `FragmentSender::new` signature changed from 4 params `(payload, rule_id, tile_size, receiver_limit)` to 3 params `(payload, rule_id, receiver_limit)`, removing the `tile_size` parameter.
- `TILE_SIZE` is now a hardcoded constant (32) instead of per-sender configurable.
- The test passes `tile_size=7` as `receiver_limit` (now the 3rd positional param) and the local `tile_size=5` variable is unused.
- Assertions still expect the old behavior: `fragment_count() == 4` (based on 20 bytes ÷ 5 tile_size), but actual `fragment_count()` is `20.div_ceil(32) = 1`.
- FCN expectations (`frags[0].fcn == 6`, etc.) are also based on window_size=7, which no longer exists.

**Fix:** Rewrite the test to use TILE_SIZE=32 or add explicit tile_size/window_size as parameters to `FragmentSender::new`.
